0022600178.text: The Pacers (2-6, 12th in the East) have lost five straight and are 0-4 at home, while the Grizzlies (6-1, 2nd in the West) are 4-0 on the road and enter after a loss, their only defeat in their last seven games. Indiana is missing Aaron Nesmith (rest), Andrew Nembhard (neck), Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), Kelly Oubre Jr. (knee bruise), Larry Nance Jr. (illness), Obi Toppin (coach's decision, soreness), Pascal Siakam (rest), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), while Memphis is without Quinten Post (ankle) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Indiana lost both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 125-106 in Indianapolis on March 1, 2026.
